title: Anthropic says it will watermark text generated by its AI models
summary: Anthropic will watermark text generated by its models, including Claude, to comply with European regulations, the company now says. The company noted that watermarking will apply to different products like Claude platform API, Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Claude Tag.
